Do you want to get to work in the evening hours, so that you have time during the day for hobbies, studies, or your family? And do you like to be physically active while working? Then this is the job for you! As a warehouse worker you earn up to €15.85 gross per hour, your travel expenses are reimbursed, and you build up a pension for your old age. You also receive an ADV allowance of 1.55% and have opportunities for advancement. And to top it all off, you even have a chance of getting a permanent contract! Curious if you qualify? Read on and apply today!

For UPS in Apeldoorn, employment agency Manpower is looking for several warehouse employees who want to work the evening shift.

As a warehouse worker at UPS Apeldoorn, you always work in a team, which ensures a combination of hard work and a pleasant atmosphere. In this position, you work carefully, accurately, and with attention to targets, performing the following tasks:

    - Processing incoming goods and packages
    
- Sorting shipments by postal code
    
- Loading and unloading trucks according to the route (depending on the shift)
    
- Scanning and checking packages and documents

This position involves physically demanding work, such as a lot of walking, carrying, lifting packages, and performing repetitive tasks.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour, including ADV allowance
    
- Long-term position on a temporary employment basis with the possibility of a permanent contract
    
- Part-time job of 20 hours per week
    
- ADV allowance of 1.55%
    
- Travel allowance of up to €7.29 net per working day
    
- Various opportunities for advancement to other positions
    
- On-the-job training when you start working
    
- Working in an international environment

    - Good command of the Dutch or English language, due to safety reasons
    
- Because of the working hours, you must be at least eighteen years old
    
- A Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) stating that you do not have a criminal record
    
-

At UPS, you’ll have the chance to work in a modern warehouse environment where no two days are the same. You and your new colleagues make sure that all parcels are sorted and end up at the right address. You’ll earn €15 per hour plus a shift allowance (depending on the shift). Read on to find out more, we’d love to tell you all about it!

What you'll be doing

Your specific duties as a warehouse assistant at UPS will depend on the department you’re working in. This could be in the inbound, outbound, order picking or warehouse operations departments, for example. Your tasks might include:

    - Receiving, checking and processing incoming goods 
    
- Picking and preparing orders for dispatch 
    
- Scanning and registering products using a hand-held scanner 
    
- Sorting, packing and repacking goods 
    
- Loading and unloading lorries 
    
- Carrying out stock management and logistical administrative tasks 

At the UPS warehouse, you’ll be working with a wide range of products, including medical supplies, high-tech goods and consumer goods. It’s therefore important that you work in accordance with the applicable safety and quality guidelines. Depending on the department, you’ll work in a standard warehouse environment or in a temperature-controlled area. Naturally, you’ll be provided with the appropriate protective clothing and instructions.

What's in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €15
    
- Shift allowances depending on the shifts worked
    
- Travel allowance 
    
- Full-time role of 40 hours per week
    
- A temporary contract via Manpower, with the prospect of a contract with UPS subject to satisfactory performance 
    
- Development opportunities via Manpower Academy (over 200 online training courses)
    
- Pension scheme via Manpower
    
- In-house training and career progression opportunities 
    
- Working within an international logistics organisation with an informal working atmosphere

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 18,69 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

*Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed

*tringgggg…* The alarm goes off early, and that doesn't make anyone happy. But for you, it's not a problem! You get out of bed every morning with a big smile on your face. As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are physically able to lift heavy crates. You enjoy working at different locations throughout the country if necessary! What you also need to know: - You can communicate in English or Dutch; - You are in possession of a driving license B; - You are available at least two shifts per week and two Saturdays per month. 
 what will you do 
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are the shopping carrier on wheels! Your working day starts by collecting the key and the route list at the collection desk. The first days, you will ride along with a buddy. You quickly grab some food from the refrigerator. Then it's time to hit the road! You drive to the right addresses via your navigation. Once you get here, you scan the correct crates with groceries with a handheld scanner. You bring the groceries to the front door. You just need to complete the payment and then you're ready to go! At the end of the day, you return to the depot. Here, you clean your bus for the next day. Do you have questions about the route? Then you can contact planning & support! :)
